purpose: Question bank for Decisions API; metadata is application-only, not accepted as API questions.
source_of_truth: Human-defined heuristic rubrics; scores are not sales predictions.
mock_policy: Mock evidence allowed in simulation only; label every derived score simulated and exclude from real business claims.
preflight: Only send questions whose required_features exist with suitable provenance; do not impute missing evidence as 0. Must distinguish observed absence from unknown.
aggregation: Normalize score indices 0..4 to 0..100 with score/4*100; weights are heuristic. Report weighted coverage. Do not interpret confidence as calibrated correctness probability.
policy_caution: Predicate probability indicates model judgment on supplied evidence, not legal/platform enforcement verdict. Verify applicable policy text and market.

question.name: V01
question.instructions: How effectively does the first 3 seconds create an immediate relevant reason to keep watching? Score only from supplied evidence, not supposed sales or platform performance. Do not treat promotional claims as verified facts.

levels.label: 0 Absent
levels.description: No discernible hook in opening.

levels.label: 1 Weak
levels.description: Opening begins without clear reason to watch.

levels.label: 2 Fair
levels.description: Topic or problem becomes recognizable, but weak urgency or relevance.

levels.label: 3 Good
levels.description: Product problem/result/curiosity is clear quickly.

levels.label: 4 Excellent
levels.description: Immediate, specific, compelling hook directly tied to a viewer need.

levels.label: 3 Good

levels.label: 4 Excellent
